title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Cyber Falcon Pharaoh's Servant PSV-047 1st Edition Common
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: This Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card features the Cyber Falcon character, with 1st Edition rarity and PSV-047 card number. It belongs to the Pharaoh's Servant set and has a normal card type. The card is Wind colored, with a machine creature/monster type and 1400 attack/power. The defense/toughness is 1200, making it a great addition to any collection.
